claims.claim_vi: The source names four disaster recovery strategies in order: backup and restore, pilot light, warm standby, hot site / multi-site.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit; only the names and order are used.

claims.claim_vi: The four levels trade running cost for recovery time and data loss; RTO is the tolerated downtime and RPO the tolerated data loss, both set by the business before choosing.
claims.verified_by: General knowledge of the author, not checked against an official document: the writing environment could only reach GitHub, and no official document for this topic is hosted there.

design_notes_vi: Khung một là bốn thẻ nối nhau từ rẻ tới đắt; khung hai là hai mốc RTO và RPO.
source_deviations: Source lists four strategies; the lesson adds RTO and RPO as the criteria for choosing and a worked choice with the question's own assumed numbers.
The ordering cheap-and-slow to expensive-and-fast is presented as a general tendency, not a price list.
